entry.author: Te Whare Wānanga o Awanuiārangi
entry.summary:
What does mana motuhake mean in the international trade space?
In this master's special topic: Mana Motuhake and Treaty-Making in the International Trade Space, learners will explore how concepts such as mana motuhake, rangatiratanga, Te Tiriti, Indigenous rights, and treaty-making extend beyond the domestic context.

Coordinated by Professor Emeritus Jane Kelsey, this Semester 2, 2026.
Explore Master's study through this paper— as part of a programme or as a one-off subject 🔗 https://www.wananga.ac.nz/media/zsxl5bgs/ihi805-mana-motuhake-and-treaty-making-in-the-international-trade-space-course-information-sem-2-2026.pdf
